stage_model.RNN-06-P0: Frozen-Checkpoint BASE Regime Scout — EXPLORATORY pre-packet. Purposes: (1) prove the candidate checkpoint runs on this workstation; (2) freeze exact checkpoint/revision/config identity; (3) cheap inference-only calibration sweep; (4) judge whether a plausible non-ceiling, non-cliff graded region is reachable within a bounded budget; (5) choose/falsify candidate model + pressure axis before lifecycle engineering. NOT confirmatory H3 evidence; does NOT qualify historical-state semantics; MUST NOT mint FIXED_BACKBONE_GRADED_REGION=QUALIFIED. Statuses: P0_GRADED_BAND = PLAUSIBLE | NOT_FOUND_WITHIN_BUDGET | MODEL_NOT_RUNNABLE.
stage_model.RNN-06A: State observability + full lifecycle checkpoint/restore/branch qualification on the pinned backend. Mints FROZEN_BACKBONE_LIFECYCLE = QUALIFIED | NOT_QUALIFIED (BIT_EXACT-or-bounded). Gate before 06B.
stage_model.RNN-06B: Confirmatory frozen-checkpoint BASE graded-region qualification (the ONLY stage that may mint FIXED_BACKBONE_GRADED_REGION = QUALIFIED | BLOCKED). No recovery mechanism.
stage_model.RNN-06C: Historical-state information-presence test (frozen linear probe + exact branch replay). Presence != exploitability. Gate before 06D.
stage_model.RNN-06D: Recovery intervention. Memory Caching is ONE candidate arm vs a matched-capacity no-history control; not assumed.
